FELIX AI SUMMARIZATION

# AI session summaries that eliminate replay time.

Felix AI Summarization uses gen AI to turn complex session replays and journeys into clear summaries. Instantly see what happened and where friction occurred without watching every click.

[View product tours](https://www.quantummetric.com/demo-center/product-tour-library?Features=felix-ai)

## How Felix AI Summarization expedites your decision making.

### Reduce time watching long, detailed session replays.

### Instantly quantify summarized friction points.

### Integrate session insights into your existing workflows.

### Summarize individual sessions for the entire user journey.

## Summarize a session in seconds.

Session replays are invaluable to understanding the customer experience, but often there’s not enough time to watch them all. With Felix AI Summarization, you can understand the entire session in seconds, with the click of a button.

## Quantify in an instant.

With a single touch, see aggregate analytics for every customer who had the exact same experience with built-in one-click quantification.

## Understand the entire journey with user-level summaries.

User-level summaries provide a holistic understanding of an individual customer's journey, encompassing their past and present interactions across different sessions and devices. This allows for the identification of patterns, friction points, and key behaviors at the user level, rather than just at the session level.

## Ask follow-up questions about summaries.

Ask questions about sessions and journeys, and get precise, validated insights, root causes, and next steps.

## Send Felix AI summaries anywhere.

Push Felix summaries and insights into your existing tools via integrations and APIs, so every team works from a single source of truth.

## Frequently asked questions.

### What is Felix AI Summarization?

Felix AI Summarization uses generative AI to automatically summarize session replays and user journeys within Quantum Metric. It condenses complex behavioral data into clear explanations of what happened during a customer’s experience, helping teams quickly understand friction, errors, and intent without manually reviewing full replays.

### How is Felix AI Summarization different from Felix Agentic?

Felix AI Summarization answers the question: “What happened in this session?” or “What happened with this user across multiple sessions?”

It generates AI-powered summaries of individual session replays and user-level journeys.

Felix Agentic answers a different question: “What changed across my business, and why?”

Felix Agentic continuously monitors KPIs and journeys across all users to proactively detect meaningful changes, identify root causes, and prioritize action.

Summarization focuses on session-level clarity. Agentic focuses on cross-session, cross-KPI, autonomous insight.

### How do Felix AI Summarization and Felix Agentic work together?

Felix AI Summarization helps teams quickly understand individual customer sessions and journeys.

Felix Agentic analyzes patterns across sessions, metrics, and journeys to detect broader changes and business impact

Teams may use Summarization to investigate specific customer experiences, and Agentic to identify systemic shifts affecting KPIs. They solve related but distinct problems.

### What AI model is Felix AI Summarization using?

Felix AI Summarization is built on Google Cloud Platform’s Gemini Pro model, enabling us to adhere to the same high privacy and data security standards of the entire Quantum Metric platform.

### Does Felix AI Summarization use my data to train a global model?

No, each customer has an individualized “instance” of a model, so it’s only trained using your specific dataset. No data is shared ever and no data is consumed to build a model outside of each customer’s use.

### Where can I find Felix AI Summarization in the Quantum Metric platform?

Within the Quantum Metric UI, summarizations are located in the session replay window and the user profile. In addition, through our RESTful API, you can push Felix summaries into any of your existing workflows and channels.
